title: Voron0.2r1 CoreXY printer
complexity: complex coupled gantry and Z axis

source.selection_rationale: Official hardware author repository; compact 120 x 120 x 120 mm CoreXY machine with two belt drives, X/Y gantry and linear rails, integrated Z lead screw and bed, geared extruder, enclosure hinges and detailed hardware. Neutral full assembly and original separate parts fit below 300 MB, including preserved ZIP and documentation.
source.selection_scope: One full original master STEP archive and its unchanged extracted member; three original standalone STEP files; twelve original printed motion-part STLs; assembly manual; license; READMEs; one unmodified firmware configuration retained only as documentary evidence.
